title: Waves screen: edit a slice's lineup and budgets before launch
lead: From the Waves screen, the owner opens a ticked slice's lineup, changes a role's vendor, model or effort and the slice's budgets, and launches with those values for that run only.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: docs/dashboard.md:193 shows `[e] edit lineup` in the wave composer. docs/design.md:147-150: "The owner can edit both" (the lineup and the fallback chain). Decision 24 (lineup.source): the chain is "editable at launch". Decision 46 (run.budgets) and design.md:529-533: budget overrides at launch. The daemon side lands in S80; this slice is the TUI and the wave.start pass-through.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/lineup.go` (new) and `internal/tui/lineup_test.go` (new): the editor.
- `internal/tui/waves.go`: the edit key opens the editor for the selected ticked item (`picked` holds each item's RunParams, :32 and :154); the Lineup column (:356-373) marks overridden roles; WaveStart already sends `a.items` (:251).
- `internal/tui/field.go`: textField (:13) for model, effort and budget values.
- `internal/tui/keys.go`: the edit key (dashboard.md:193 shows e); Launch is l (:35).
- `internal/tui/model.go`: runAction (:634) already carries `items []daemon.RunParams`; no new field is needed unless the editor state lives on the model.
- `internal/tui/view.go` and `internal/tui/tui_test.go`: draw the editor; TestDashboardDocsListTheNavigationKeys with the new key.
- `testdata/golden/lineup-100x30-color.txt` and `testdata/golden/lineup-100x30-mono.txt` (new).
- `docs/dashboard.md`: Waves (:183-195), the editor keys.
- Reference only, no change: the daemon already takes `Lineup` and `Budgets` per wave item (`internal/daemon/runs.go:47-48`, `startWave` :419) and has `TestWaveStartChecksOverridesAndExpectedPerItem` (`internal/daemon/wave_test.go:198`), landed by S80.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestLineupEditorStartsFromPlan: the editor shows each role's entry from the item's plan (the matrix default) and the plan's budgets.
- TestLineupEditorChangesOneRole: changing the implementer's model marks only that role as overridden.
- TestLineupEditorHasNoGateField: the gate follows the reviewer (design.md:580; engine/states.go:248).
- TestLineupEditRePlans: closing the editor with a change calls Plan with the override and keeps the returned plan as the item's Expected; a Plan error shows verbatim and keeps the old plan.
- TestLineupEditorEscDiscards: esc leaves the item's lineup and plan as they were.
- TestLineupBudgetsMustBeNumbers: a budget value that is not a whole number of zero or more is refused in the editor, with no call.
- TestWaveStartCarriesOverrides (tui): y sends each edited item's Lineup and Budgets in WaveStart; an item with no edit sends none.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.
- The daemon pass-through is covered by the existing `TestWaveStartChecksOverridesAndExpectedPerItem`; it must keep passing.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests first. Run them and confirm they fail.
2. lineup.go: an editor over one item's plan. Rows: implementer and reviewer, each with vendor, model and effort; then budget minutes and tokens. The interaction follows record 136 (`ui.lineup-editor`, decided 2026-10-20: cycle the matrix rows, plus a key that opens the three fields).
3. waves.go: the edit key opens the editor for the selected ticked item. On close with a change, call Plan with the override and keep the new plan.
4. The Lineup column marks overridden roles.
5. Carry each item's override on its RunParams in `picked`; WaveStart already sends them.
6. Run go test ./internal/tui -update and review testdata/golden/lineup-*.txt.
7. Update docs/dashboard.md.

Decided 2026-10-20: (a) record 136 (`ui.lineup-editor`): cycle the matrix rows, plus a key that opens vendor, model and effort fields for a custom entry. (b) records 132, 133 and 134 from S80: free entry, run only, full chain. Nothing is open.
Not in this slice: editing from the S52 single launch; editing the fallback chain beyond the primary entry, until S49 runs the chain; any daemon change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review testdata/golden/lineup-100x30-color.txt and lineup-100x30-mono.txt.
- Run TestLineup* and TestWaveStart* by name with go test -run.
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner edits one slice's implementer model in the Waves screen, launches the wave, and finds that model in that run's run.json and status, with the matrix unchanged.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S83: Waves screen lineup and budget editor".
